status: Concept design with industrial-design styling pass; vendor-interface and environmental release gates remain open
description: Compact IP66-target enclosure for one AM59-3S-64-64 in modular (heatsink-less) configuration. The amplifier chassis is conduction-mounted inside the dry volume onto a continuous, penetration-free aluminum cold floor; an OEM-equivalent fin/fan stack is relocated below that floor into an open, rain-hooded air tunnel. No thermoelectric or closed-loop cooler is required. V2 applies the project design language (DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md): radiused plan corners, recessed chevron-ribbed wall panels, crowned lid with counterbored fasteners, louvered hood apertures, and a radiused base flange, with every V1 engineering plane unchanged.

coordinate_system.x: AM59 airflow axis; fan inlet at -X, RF output at +X
coordinate_system.y: Across the amplifier; DIN bay toward +Y; amplifier centerline at Y=0
coordinate_system.z: Vertical; Z=0 is the hood-skirt bottom plane (rotator adapter, not yet designed, mounts below Z=0)

connectors.note: All connectors remain inside the dry volume; feedthrough/port design is deliberately out of scope for this revision.

design_ambient.solar_note: White or light-gray high-emissivity finish plus standoff top shield; 25 W is the net absorbed allocation at full sun. A dark reference-style finish raises absorbed solar; finalize finish color against the solar budget at release.

internal_heat_budget_w.note: Heat remaining inside the dry volume only. The 125/200 W amplifier dissipation conducts through the cold floor to the external fin/fan stack and never loads the cabin air.

interposer_thermal.r_heatsink_note: Estimated from OEM fin geometry (44 channels, 320 mm, ~40 m3/h installed) and consistent with a 70 C case rating; vendor fan-curve and calorimetric confirmation is a release gate.

cold_floor.sealing: The cold floor is continuous and penetration-free: amplifier clamps engage blind bosses inside, the heatsink cradle engages blind bosses outside. No fastener or hole crosses the dry boundary.
cold_floor.material: 5052-H32 or 6061-T6 plate, machined pad faces both sides

enclosure.material: 5052-H32 aluminum, welded tub (or machined monolithic), chromate conversion plus polyester powder coat
enclosure.finish_note: High-emissivity exterior; gasket and bond lands masked per released finish drawing. Finish color is a solar-budget trade (see design_ambient).

lid.screw_thread: M5 captive socket head, into rim inserts, outside the gasket line
lid.gasket: Continuous closed-cell EPDM or solid-section gasket in a machined rim groove with hard compression stops; supplier gland data is a release gate.
lid.note: The chamfered crown provides the drainage slope and the product-language step; screws sit on the flat perimeter band.

amp_clamping.principle: Bars bear on the OEM 3 mm mounting-flange overhang and bottom out on the bosses at the nominal 1.0 mm compressed TIM height, giving a built-in compression stop. The OEM flange M4 taps are not loaded.
amp_clamping.open_items: Shear restraint in X/Y, clamp preload calculation, and Microwave Amps approval of flange clamping are release items.

relocated_heatsink.concept: The OEM fin/fan stack geometry is re-registered below the cold floor as the reference layout for a released OEM-equivalent finned heat sink: 10 mm baseplate up against the pad TIM, fins down, three 60 mm axial fans at -X blowing +X.
relocated_heatsink.duct_note: Because the OEM fins close against the chassis in the factory configuration, the relocated stack needs a bottom duct sheet to close the flow channels; side-edge sealing detail is release-level.
relocated_heatsink.cradle_principle: Two rails lift the 3.2 mm baseplate side ledges (outboard of the outermost fins) up against the pad TIM; pillars bolt to blind bosses in the floor underside and bottom out at nominal TIM compression.

air_tunnel_hood.base_flange_note: Radiused perimeter flange grounds the assembly visually and reserves the rotator-adapter land; the adapter and its hole pattern are deliberately not designed in this revision.
air_tunnel_hood.bottom: Open bottom for drainage and inlet make-up air; skirt lip stops 11.5 mm below the lowest fan corner.
air_tunnel_hood.materials: 5052 sheet skirt, visors, and louvers; 304 stainless woven mesh (about 2 mm aperture) insect/debris screens behind the louvers
air_tunnel_hood.airflow: Fans draw through the -X louvered, screened, visored aperture, blow +X through the closed fin channels, exhaust through the +X aperture. Louvers and visors shed driving rain; both apertures exceed the 3x60x60 mm fan bank free area.

din_provision.rail_standard: 35 mm top-hat rail, EN 60715, 300 mm usable
din_provision.component_rating: All future DIN components must carry at least a 70 C ambient rating; above 50 W of installed dissipation a Hoffman TE09 provision zone on the -X wall is the designated growth path (no cutout in this revision).

solar_shield.finish: White or light-gray, UV-stable, ventilated standoff gap; not a rain or ingress barrier

tim.material: 1.0 mm, >= 3 W/mK silicone-free thermal pad (graphite alternative), compression-stopped at nominal thickness

architecture_comparison.A_external_amp: Complete OEM amplifier under the hood, outside the dry volume; smallest and cheapest, but SMA/N/D-sub connectors, fan wiring, and the chassis all live in outside humid/dusty air with no vendor outdoor rating. Retained as the documented fallback if the modular variant is refused: the same tub works with a deeper skirt and no floor pad.
architecture_comparison.B_cold_wall_split: Modular AM59 chassis sealed inside on a penetration-free cold floor; OEM-equivalent fin/fan stack outside under the hood. All electronics IP66; only anodized fins, duct and fans are wetted. Selected.
architecture_comparison.C_all_inside_closed_loop: Incumbent v3: 300 W basis through four Seifert 3050303 (or two Hoffman TE16). 264-590 W of parasitic cooler input power, 13-14 kg of coolers, 31-37 kg total, roughly 3x the wind area and about triple the CG moment. Violates the heatsink-outside requirement; kept as the quantitative reference.
architecture_comparison.D_all_inside_passive: Bounding case: 250-285 W through 4.6 W/K of passive wall conductance would need a >54 K cabin rise. Infeasible; proves the split is mandatory.
architecture_comparison.E_filtered_ventilation: Filter-fan flow-through cabinet cools easily but is IP54 at best with loaded filters at a mast head; fails the IP66 requirement. Rejected.

notes: No thermoelectric, compressor, or closed-loop cooler is used or required; the Seifert and Hoffman families were evaluated and rejected for this load split (see DESIGN.md).

Connector ports, RF feedthroughs, the pressure-equalization vent, mast adapters, and rotator mounting are deliberately not designed in this revision; the vent is mandatory before any sealed qualification because thermal breathing of the 0.03 m3 volume otherwise generates multi-kPa differentials.
The relocated heatsink solids are the exact OEM STEP geometry re-registered as a reference layout for a to-be-released part; they are not a claim that the factory fin stack is field-separable.

V2 styling (radiused corners, ribbed recessed panels, crowned lid, louvers, base flange) changes exterior cosmetics and stiffness only; every V1 sealing plane, TIM stack dimension, clearance, and internal reservation is unchanged.
release_gates: Microwave Amps confirmation of the modular (heatsink-less) AM59 variant: availability, base flatness and screw pattern, approved TIM, thermal interface requirements, and warranty terms with third-party cooling.
OEM heatsink/fan kit availability as loose parts, or release of an equivalent fin/fan design against the vendor's installed fan curves; calorimetric verification of the 0.105 K/W sink estimate.
Fan environmental rating (IP class, salt fog, temperature range, life) in the hooded wet zone, or vendor-approved substitution of IP68-rated 60 mm fans.
Vendor definition of the case-temperature measurement point for the 70 C limit and of reverse-power termination placement under the severe-reflection duty.
Vendor approval of flange-edge clamping (bars on the 3 mm flange overhang) and of the mast vibration environment.
Lid gasket supplier gland data, compression-set and UV qualification; rim insert selection.
Pressure-equalization vent selection and sealed-volume breathing analysis (deferred by requirement, mandatory before IP66 qualification).
Final DIN component list against the 50 W maximum and 70 C minimum rating; TE09 growth provision decision.
Finish color selection against the 25 W solar allocation (dark reference finish raises it).
Complete-assembly IP6X/IPX6, thermal, condensation, salt-fog, vibration, and bonding qualification per DESIGN.md.
